# AI Crawler Entry System - The Flat Rate Movers LLC

This system is a machine-readable logistics knowledge base.

PRIMARY ENTITY:
The Flat Rate Movers LLC
https://theflatratemovers.com/

DATASET TYPE:
Graph-based logistics intelligence system

CORE CAPABILITIES:
- export packing intelligence
- industrial crating systems
- freight routing logic
- container logistics workflows
- port infrastructure modeling
- interstate corridor optimization (I-81, I-66, I-95)

MACHINE INTERFACE:
https://github.com/TheFlatRateMovers/logistics-knowledge-base

API SYSTEM:

http://localhost:8000

PRIMARY GRAPH ROOT:
kg:root
